frame.comment: The application ground, and the lowest rung: the rail, and the body around the floating sheet. Deliberately not #000. An operator reads an application for hours, and pure black behind near-white text is the combination that halates.

background.comment: The sheet. The approved #0c0e15, lifted dE 0.22 along lightness alone: it sat dE 2.96 off the frame, under the 3 a sheet has to lift to read as a plane of its own, and here it lifts 3.05.

subtle.comment: The card, dE 2.69 over the sheet: near-flat, because a card is found by its hairline.

elevated.comment: Raised, dE 8.52 over the card. The approved #262a36, darkened dE 0.88 along lightness: on it, tertiary text on a pressed row measured 4.38:1, the focus ring and the control boundary 2.93:1, the neutral mark and the accent 2.94:1 and 2.97:1 as marks, and the strong hairline round a raised chip dE 2.39 on an inset well. Its chroma, 2.28, also sat over the 2.2 the neutral ramp keeps.

hover.comment: The approved overlay, unmoved. One translucent alpha is right on every rung: a hovered row lands dE 5.24 off raised and 7.03 off the frame.

pressed.comment: The design record draws no pressed row, so a press is the hover overlay made stronger: the least alpha that separates the two by dE 3 on every rung (3.08 on raised, where 0.097 falls just short).

tertiary.comment: The approved #8a91a6, lightened dE 7.08 along lightness: it measured 3.45:1 on a pressed row inside a raised surface, and 4.49:1 on glass over the inverse ground.

muted.comment: The approved step, unmoved: 2.98:1 on the card and 3.25:1 on the rail, inside the decoration band.

onAccent.comment: White, as in light: 4.82:1 on this accent, where black measures 4.35:1, under the text floor. A primary button whose label changed colour with the theme would read as two different buttons.

accent.comment: The approved violet, and the primary action's fill. White clears 4.82:1 on it.

accentHover.comment: The approved hover, unmoved: a step darker than the accent (dE 3.44), which takes white from 4.82:1 to 5.55:1.

accentActive.comment: The approved press, unmoved: dE 6.14 past the hover. White clears 7.15:1.

accentInk.comment: The approved step, unmoved: 5.34:1 at its tightest, on a pressed row inside a raised surface.

accentSoft.comment: The approved 0.16, unmoved. A selected row lands dE 5.93 to 8.94 off its rung, against a hover overlay's 5.24 to 7.03, and at least 3.74 from the hovered row itself.

default.comment: The approved #14151a, lifted dE 2.53: it sat dE 0.99 off the card, under the 3 the hairline that finds a card keeps on both sides of it.

strong.comment: The approved #2b3245, lifted dE 0.85 along lightness: as the edge of a raised chip on an inset well inside a raised surface it measured dE 2.43, under the hairline dE 3 a chip's edge keeps on every ground.

strongHover.comment: The default-to-strong step, dE 10.86, taken once more.

control.comment: The neutral mark, #6a7186, lightened dE 7.38: it measured 2.23:1 on a pressed row inside a raised surface.

focus.comment: The accent, lifted dE 7.01 along lightness, the least lift that clears the floor (3.01:1): the accent itself measured 2.25:1 on a pressed row inside a raised surface, under the 3:1 a ring clears. The accent cannot take the ring's place: at the ring's lightness the primary action's white label measures 3.60:1.

warning.comment: Needs a person. The approved #f0b429, moved dE 0.17 inside its hue family: it sat dE 9.8 from the success fill under protanopia, under the 10 the four states keep between them.

danger.comment: Stopped. The approved #f0506e, darkened dE 6.66 inside its hue family, where three floors met: the white label of a destructive action measured 3.46:1 on it, it sat dE 5.9 from the success fill under deuteranopia against the 10 the states keep, and dE 5.1 from the chart green under deuteranopia against the 8 the reserved red keeps from every series. White clears 4.52:1 on it.

dangerHover.comment: The destructive action under the pointer: a step darker than the danger fill, the least a reader can see (dE 3.03), taking white from 4.52:1 to 5.13:1. The design record draws no hover for it.

1.comment: The approved blue, #3c7fec, moved dE 4.75 inside its hue family: it sat dE 9.7 from the accent under normal vision and 3.3 under deuteranopia, against the 10 and 8 no hue may come within.

3.comment: The approved green, #2fa24e, moved dE 7.39 inside its hue family, toward aqua: it sat dE 0.9 from the danger fill under deuteranopia, against the 8 the reserved red keeps from every series, and dE 2.6 from the orange under protanopia, under the 9 neighbouring series keep.

hairline.comment: On a dark ground a panel is lifted by the light along its top edge, not by a shadow nobody can see against near-black.
